title: GSY Facility
description: Mirrors the Rust FacilitySchema (snake_case wire form).

facility_id.description: Strict hyphenated UUIDs are lowercased; other unpadded identities remain case-sensitive, including hex-shaped strings.

site_id.description: The site_name of the site the facility belongs to.

owner_id.description: Uses the same off-chain identity normalization as facility_id.
